plugins.name: diffmode-growth-tactics
plugins.description: Free growth-ideation for teams that can't outspend their competitors. Point /run-growth-tactics at your product URL and get 7-9 specific, unconventional growth tactics built for your constraints — plus the whole research workspace behind them: a competitor teardown, an audience jobs-to-be-done map, an acquisition-tactics audit, and three strategy reports, each one a brief you can reuse. It combines proven growth mechanisms from fresh case-study research instead of a generic channel list. Runs locally into ./<slug>/ in your cwd; no account or API key; Perplexity optional, with free built-in web search otherwise.
